questions.question: What was the average Belgian day-ahead price in January 2026?
questions.sql:
SELECT AVG(price_eur_mwh) AS avg_day_ahead_price
FROM gold.fct_day_ahead_price
WHERE market_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31'

questions.question: What was the highest Belgian day-ahead quarter-hour price in the dataset, and when did it happen (Brussels time)?
questions.sql:
SELECT MAX(price_be_eur_mwh) AS max_price, ANY_VALUE(interval_start_local) AS max_price_time
FROM gold.fct_be_system
WHERE market_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2026-10-12'

questions.question: ¿Cuántos cuartos de hora tuvieron precio day-ahead negativo en Bélgica en mayo de 2026?
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM gold.fct_day_ahead_price
WHERE market_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31'
  AND price_eur_mwh < 0

questions.question: Which bidding zone had the lowest average day-ahead price over the whole period, and what was it?
questions.sql:
SELECT bidding_zone, AVG(price_eur_mwh) AS avg_price_eur_mwh
FROM gold.fct_day_ahead_price
GROUP BY bidding_zone
ORDER BY avg_price_eur_mwh ASC
LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was the average absolute price spread between Belgium and the Netherlands in March 2026?
questions.sql:
SELECT AVG(avg_abs_spread_eur_mwh) AS avg_abs_spread_eur_mwh
FROM gold.mart_daily_price_spread
WHERE market_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND neighbour = 'NL'

questions.question: In July 2026, in what share of quarter-hours did Belgian and French prices converge?
questions.sql:
SELECT pct_price_converged
FROM gold.mart_monthly_border_flow_price
WHERE month = DATE '2026-07-01' AND neighbour = 'FR'

questions.question: In 2026, how did the average Belgian day-ahead price on weekends compare with weekdays?
questions.sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN day_name IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') THEN price_eur_mwh ELSE NULL END) AS avg_weekend_price,
    AVG(CASE WHEN day_name NOT IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') THEN price_eur_mwh ELSE NULL END) AS avg_weekday_price
FROM 
    gold.fct_day_ahead_price
JOIN 
    gold.dim_date ON gold.fct_day_ahead_price.market_date = gold.dim_date.market_date
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM gold.fct_day_ahead_price.market_date) = 2026

questions.question: In June 2026, which hour of the day (Brussels time) had the lowest average Belgian day-ahead price?
questions.sql:
SELECT 
    DATE '2026-06-01' + INTERVAL 'quarter' * EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM interval_start_local) AS hour_start,
    AVG(price_eur_mwh) AS avg_price_eur_mwh
FROM 
    gold.fct_day_ahead_price
WHERE 
    market_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM interval_start_local)
ORDER BY 
    avg_price_eur_mwh ASC
LIMIT 1

questions.question: How much energy (GWh) did Belgium export net across all its borders from 1 January to 12 October 2026?

FROM gold.fct_be_system

questions.question: On the Belgium-Netherlands border, what share of the quarter-hours with a meaningful price signal had physical flow running against the price?
questions.sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN flow_vs_price = 'against_price' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS pct_against_price
FROM 
    gold.fct_border_flow_price
WHERE 
    neighbour = 'NL'

questions.question: Which Belgian border has the highest share of physical flow running against the price signal?
questions.sql:
SELECT neighbour, pct_against_price
FROM gold.mart_monthly_border_flow_price
ORDER BY pct_against_price DESC
LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many border-days were flagged as a relevant deviation between ENTSO-E and Elia, and which border had the most?
questions.sql:
SELECT 
    neighbour, 
    COUNT(*) AS relevant_deviation_days
FROM 
    gold.mart_daily_flow_reconciliation
WHERE 
    status = 'relevant_deviation'
GROUP BY 
    neighbour
ORDER BY 
    relevant_deviation_days DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM gold.mart_daily_flow_reconciliation
